value.name: Dicky enters the Trap
value.description: Dicky steps into the processing room where inmates are brought in.
evidence: He steps into the Trap, the room in which inmates arrive to be processed

value.name: Officer recognizes Dicky
value.description: A corrections officer is surprised to see Dicky and addresses him by name.
evidence: CORRECTIONS OFFICER (stands, surprised) Dicky!? What're you doin' here?

value.name: Dicky pleads to go home
value.description: Dicky says he needs to go home and reassure someone that everything will be okay.
evidence: DICKY I gotta go home, Harry. I gotta tell Dicky it's gonna be okay, he don't gotta cry.

value.name: Officer warns Dicky away
value.description: The officer puts a hand on Dicky's shoulder and tells him to go back upstairs before he gets written up.
evidence: CORRECTIONS OFFICER (steps out, puts a hand on DICKY'S SHOULDER) Get back upstairs before I write ya up.

value.name: Dicky insists the crying will stop
value.description: Dicky repeats that the person he is worried about will not have to cry anymore.
evidence: DICKY - He don't gotta cry no more.

value.name: Officer sends Dicky back upstairs
value.description: The officer tells Dicky he cannot be there and orders him to return upstairs.
evidence: CORRECTIONS OFFICER I don't know what you're talking about, Dicky, but you can't be here. You gotta go back up.

value.name: Dicky returns to the corridor
value.description: Dicky turns away from the officer and heads back toward the upper floor.
evidence: Dicky looks at Corrections Officer 2, turns and heads back.

value.name: Dicky walks through the corridor
value.description: Dicky moves down the second-floor corridor past the echoing sounds of the prison.
evidence: CORRIDOR, 2ND FLOOR - B.H.C. - NIGHT. Dicky walking down the dimly lit hall, shadows dancing off walls, distant cheering, screaming echoing...

value.name: Dicky enters the kitchen
value.description: Dicky goes into the dark kitchen after walking the hall.

value.name: Dicky kneels to pray
value.description: Dicky sinks to his knees on the cement floor and bows his head in prayer.
evidence: Dicky sinks to his knees onto the hard grey cement floor and bows his head to pray.
